topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 77 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 11 common project-authored base contract(s) (uinitializable, ucontrollerprovider, ureentrancyguard). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
